record.question: Both Sam and Sean are engineers, __________?
record.explanation: Answer D: aren't they. The compound subject “Sam and Sean” takes “aren’t they?”. Independent check: The subject is plural and the auxiliary “are” is positive, so the tag is “aren’t they?” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/question-tags.
